known_gaps: Global release availability is unverified in the frozen catalog.

The content simulation executes no break damage or gauge accumulation, so the staged static Break Intensity points have no live consumer yet. The points are staged in the field GearProcConfig::JiaojuanBreak::break_intensity_bonus; a future break execution must read that field and join them as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum. The adapter-to-zone link is a Q1-V1 return condition, not a tested path.

projection.rs now reports "runtime_execution_validated": false (coordinator honesty fix, batch 10, crowbar precedent): the flag covers only proc staging/validation plus the executed Broken damage-bonus path, so true would overstate what is validated — the staged Break Intensity points have no live consumer (Q1-V1 return condition). Caveat: 'broken damage bonus executed; break-intensity staging only'. Asserted by jiaojuan_projection_binds_five_curves_rejects_group_and_unit_changes.
No native break gauge exists in the runtime, so Broken-gated damage only occurs when a scenario declares the content-owned Broken status tag; native break-triggered states are unmodeled.

name: Film - MANISH
tested_hypotheses: Both passive clauses are static (always-on): the frozen description names no trigger, cast, or duration, so no timed buff is staged and no ICD is modeled.

Broken state is detected through the content-owned ntesim.status.broken target status tag; the tag name is not asserted to be the native GameplayTag because the frozen tables expose no break-gauge binding and the runtime simulates no break gauge.

The {1} Broken damage ratio joins the single additive damage-bonus zone (M_bonus) only while the target carries an active Broken tag; it is not a final, special, or multiplicative factor, and no ATK bonus is granted.

The {0} Break Intensity points are static points joining the break damage zone as 1 + BI/300 + break_bonus_sum; they do not enter gauge accumulation (gauge_shred = base_shred x (1 + break_efficiency) x ...).
The buff curve rows are shared with fork_oulaquantao; the same frozen values serve both weapons.
